text.aria-label: Title text 'Size of D8's merged falls against the reading before them. Dashed grey: the fall a folded reading would show when k units of 2 MW start (L minus the absolute value of L minus 2k), for k = 1, 2, 3 (upper to lower at 6 MVA is k = 3, 2, 1).'
text.tspan: Size of D8's merged falls against the reading before them. Dashed grey: the fall a folded
reading would show when k units of 2 MW start (L minus the absolute value of L minus 2k), for k
= 1, 2, 3 (upper to lower at 6 MVA is k = 3, 2, 1).
